description.en: Picks a recipe (or generator-CLI), reserves a port, scaffolds the project, runs init.sh and a smoke test against the empty skeleton
description.de: Wählt ein Recipe (oder Generator-CLI), reserviert einen Port, scaffoldet das Projekt, führt init.sh aus und macht einen Smoke-Test gegen das leere Skelett

instructions: Initialisiert ein neues App-Verzeichnis basierend auf dem Build-Plan aus saas-spec-to-buildplan. Ruft die deterministische factory-CLI auf — keine LLM-Aktion in diesem Workflow.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-/home/flo/Entwicklung/IdeaProjects/saas-factory}"
SLUG="{{ slug }}"
STACK_HINT="{{ stack_hint }}"
SPEC_TYPE="{{ spec_type }}"
if [ -z "$SLUG" ]; then
  echo 'ERROR: slug fehlt' >&2; exit 2
fi
RECIPE=$("$FACTORY/tools/factory" pick-recipe ${STACK_HINT:+--stack "$STACK_HINT"} ${SPEC_TYPE:+--type "$SPEC_TYPE"})
PORT=$("$FACTORY/tools/factory" port --reserve --app "$SLUG")
echo "RECIPE=$RECIPE"
echo "PORT=$PORT"
echo "TARGET=$FACTORY/$SLUG"
echo "SLUG=$SLUG"

set -euo pipefail
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-/home/flo/Entwicklung/IdeaProjects/saas-factory}"
SLUG="{{ slug }}"
PREVIOUS='{{ previous_output }}'
RECIPE=$(echo "$PREVIOUS" | grep '^RECIPE=' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-)
PORT=$(echo "$PREVIOUS" | grep '^PORT=' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-)
TARGET="$FACTORY/$SLUG"
echo "Scaffolding $SLUG → $TARGET (recipe=$RECIPE port=$PORT)"
"$FACTORY/tools/factory" scaffold --recipe "$RECIPE" --target "$TARGET" --name "$SLUG" --port "$PORT"

set -euo pipefail
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-/home/flo/Entwicklung/IdeaProjects/saas-factory}"
SLUG="{{ slug }}"
TARGET="$FACTORY/$SLUG"
cd "$TARGET"
if [ -f docker-compose.yml ]; then
  docker compose build 2>&1 | tail -50
  docker compose up -d 2>&1 | tail -20
  sleep 10
fi
"$FACTORY/tools/factory" smoke "$TARGET" --timeout 60 || echo 'Smoke-Test fehlgeschlagen (non-fatal beim leeren Skelett)'
